name: Ghosted Fates
source:
Trapped in a manor where the worlds of the living and the dead intertwine, you discover that love is your only hope of survival.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
被困在生者世界和死者世界交织在一起的庄园里，你发现爱是你生存的唯一希望。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
